# Dora

## Overview

- **Age:** Fifteen years old  <sub>[v4 c4 P2](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0002)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c8 P5](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0005)</sub>

## Appearance

Dora is fair with long, sleek curls that never get out of order, gentle and mild hazel eyes, and a straight nose. She is neat and proper, often dressed in a nicely starched white dress and black sash, looking as if she had just been starched and ironed.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c8 P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044)_

## Personality

Dora is quiet, prim, well-behaved, and remarkably composed, remaining unruffled even during severe disruptions or emotional occasions. She is systematic, careful, neat, and industrious, diligently taking on small household tasks and studies without needing to be told twice. Though demure and sensible, her unchanging and predictable nature leads some to describe her as placid and somewhat monotonous.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 c24 P10](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0010), [v2 c24 P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025), [v2 c26 P32](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0032), [v2 c26 P33](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0033), [v3 c3 P1](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0001), [v4 c4 P5](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0005)_

- Capable child-minding skills  <sub>[v4 c4 P3](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0003), [v4 c4 P5](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0005)</sub>

## History

Dora was raised alongside her twin brother Davy under the care of a sick relative named Mary until she died, after which Marilla Cuthbert took the orphans into Green Gables with Anne Shirley's help. Unlike her mischievous brother, Dora quickly proved to be a quiet, helpful, and model child who faithfully performed her duties and memorized her Sunday lessons like a little machine. She attended school in Avonlea, where she once became terrified of going upstairs in the dark after hearing tales of a classmate's deceased uncle. As she grew older, she maintained her sensible, neat, and reliable demeanour, assisting dutifully with chores and gardening at Green Gables. On the day of Anne's wedding, fifteen-year-old Dora helped entertain Diana's young children, preparing to inherit Anne's old porch room after her departure.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c8 P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 c14 P30](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0030), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 c21 P2](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0002), [v2 c21 P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 c24 P10](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0010), [v4 c4 P2](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0002), [v4 c4 P3](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0003)_

- Her father died when she was a baby and her mother was chronically ill  <sub>[v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033)</sub>
- Brought to Green Gables by Marilla Cuthbert after her relative passed away  <sub>[v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001)</sub>
